tex_content.html:
Theorem
[The standard flow exists exactly on $[0,1)$] ↗ thm:standard-solution-canonical-neighborhoods ↗ prop:standard-flow-asymptotic-cylinder

$T=1$.
Proof

↗ cor:standard-flow-time-bound-one ↗ thm:standard-solution-canonical-neighborhoods ↗ prop:standard-flow-asymptotic-cylinder ↗ shiw/deriv ↗ kaplimit ↗ asympvol ↗ thm:bishop-gromov ↗ lem:distance-nonincreasing \sketch Assume $T<1$. Cylindrical asymptotics and canonical neighborhoods give a smooth limit outside a compact set. A blowup point has a $\kappa $-solution limit, so the preceding claim and Bishop–Gromov force the volume of a fixed positive-volume subset of the exterior limit to vanish, a contradiction. Thus $T\ge 1$; combine with $T\le 1$.

□
